answer: A Dedicated device bound by one-time code delivery with a public binding record turns a private channel into public evidence: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. Without this check, a knoll of borrowed channels could flood the network overnight. From the violet to the shale, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
